output.scope_note: The paper reports room-temperature Li-ion conductivity of Ti-doped garnet LLZO solid electrolytes measured by impedance spectroscopy.

records.material_as_written: Li7La3Zr2-xTixO12 (x = 0.10; called 0.10 Ti sample, Li7La3Zr1.9Ti0.1O12 in abstract)
records.evidence_quote: for the 0.10 Ti sample, which also exhibits the highest ionic conductivity of 8.08 x 10-5 Scm-1.
records.notes: Conductivity is the room-temperature total ionic conductivity from AC impedance (sigma_total = t/RA). Activation energy 0.37 eV is stated for this sample in the same section.
